adventure.def_en: An exciting and sometimes difficult journey.
adventure.example_en: Our trip to the caves was a real adventure.
adventure.example_fa: سفر ما به غارها ماجراجویی واقعی بود.

an.def_en: The word for one thing, before a vowel sound.

and.def_en: A word that joins two things.

animal.def_en: A living thing that is not a plant or a person.
animal.example_en: The elephant is the biggest animal here.

apple.def_en: A round fruit that can be red or green.
apple.example_en: She eats an apple every day.
apple.example_fa: او هر روز یک سیب می‌خورد.

as.def_en: A little word that compares two things.
as.example_en: It is as big as my hand.
as.example_fa: به اندازهٔ دست من بزرگ است.

at.def_en: A word that shows where something is.

ball.def_en: A round thing you throw or kick.

bat.def_en: A wooden stick used to hit a ball.
bat.example_en: He hit the ball with a bat.
bat.example_fa: او با چوب به توپ زد.

bed.example_en: My bed is soft and warm.

bird.def_en: An animal with wings and feathers that can fly.
bird.example_en: The bird sings in the morning.

can.def_en: A word that says you are able to do something.

cap.def_en: A soft hat with a flat part at the front.

cat.def_en: A small animal with soft fur that says meow.

celebrate.def_en: To do something special for a happy event.
celebrate.example_en: We celebrate her birthday on Friday.

challenge.def_en: Something difficult that tests what you can do.

change.example_en: The weather can change quickly here.

clean.def_en: Not dirty, with nothing left on it.

courage.def_en: Being brave when something frightens you.

curious.def_en: Wanting to know or learn something.

cut.def_en: To divide something with a knife or scissors.

describe.def_en: To say what someone or something is like.

discover.def_en: To find something for the first time.

discover.example_fa: راه تازه‌ای در جنگل کشف کردیم.

dish.def_en: A plate that food is served on, or the food itself.

dog.def_en: A friendly animal that barks and wags its tail.
dog.example_en: My dog runs to the door when I come home.
dog.example_fa: سگ من وقتی به خانه می‌رسم به سمت در می‌دود.

eloquent.def_en: Speaking or writing in a clear, beautiful way.

end.example_en: The end of the story is sad.

find.def_en: To see something you were looking for.

fish.def_en: An animal that lives in water and swims.
fish.example_en: The fish swims around the bowl.

fog.def_en: Cloud that is close to the ground.

frog.def_en: A small green animal that jumps and lives near water.
frog.example_en: The frog jumped into the pond.

fun.def_en: The feeling of enjoying yourself; play that makes you smile.

garden.def_en: The ground around a house where plants grow.

go.def_en: To move from one place to another.
go.example_en: We go to school by bus.

hand.def_en: The part of your body at the end of your arm.
hand.example_en: Raise your hand if you know.
hand.example_fa: اگر می‌دانی دستت را بالا ببر.

harvest.def_en: The time when crops are gathered.
harvest.example_en: The harvest comes at the end of summer.

hat.def_en: Something you wear on your head.
hat.example_en: I wear a hat in summer.

he.def_en: The word for a man or a boy.

his.def_en: The word that shows something belongs to a boy or a man.

hit.def_en: To touch something hard and fast.
hit.example_en: Hit the ball with the bat.

house.example_en: Our house has a red door.

imagine.def_en: To make a picture in your mind.
imagine.example_en: Imagine a castle in the clouds.
imagine.example_fa: قلعه‌ای در ابرها را تصور کن.

improve.example_en: I read every day to improve my English.

in.def_en: A word that shows something is inside.
in.example_en: The cat is in the box.

intricate.def_en: Having many small parts arranged carefully.
intricate.example_en: The box had an intricate pattern.
intricate.example_fa: جعبه نقش و نگاری ظریف داشت.

is.def_en: The form of be that goes with he, she or it.

island.def_en: Land with water all around it.

it.def_en: The word for a thing you are talking about.

journey.def_en: The act of travelling from one place to another.

kitchen.def_en: The room where you cook food.
kitchen.example_en: Dad is cooking in the kitchen.

leg.def_en: The part of your body you stand on.
leg.example_en: My leg hurts after the run.
leg.example_fa: بعد از دویدن پام درد می‌کند.

listen.def_en: To pay attention to a sound.
listen.example_en: Listen to the birds in the morning.

make.def_en: To put things together until something new exists.

man.example_en: The man is reading a book.

mat.def_en: A small flat piece of material on the floor.

me.def_en: The word for yourself after a verb.

message.example_en: I sent a message to my teacher.

moon.def_en: The round light you see in the night sky.

mountain.def_en: A very high hill with rock on it.

net.def_en: Cloth with holes in it that catches things.

no.def_en: The word that says something is not there.

of.def_en: A word that shows what something belongs to or is made of.

on.def_en: A word that shows something is on top.

or.def_en: A word that gives a second choice.

orange.def_en: The colour you get by mixing red and yellow.

pan.example_en: Heat the oil in the pan.

peas.def_en: Small round green vegetables that grow in a pod.

pen.def_en: A tool you write with that has ink inside.

pencil.def_en: A thin stick you write with.
pencil.example_en: My pencil is yellow and sharp.
pencil.example_fa: مداد من زرد و نوک‌تیز است.

picture.def_en: A drawing or photo of something.

planet.def_en: A big round world that moves around a star.

pot.def_en: A deep round container for cooking.

practice.def_en: Doing something many times so you get better.

rabbit.def_en: A small animal with long ears that hops.
rabbit.example_en: The rabbit is eating a carrot.

rain.def_en: Water that falls from the sky.

red.def_en: The colour of a tomato or a stop sign.

resilient.def_en: Able to recover quickly after something difficult.
resilient.example_en: Children are often more resilient than adults.

run.def_en: To move fast on your feet.
run.example_en: I run to the gate every morning.
run.example_fa: هر صبح به سمت در می‌دوم.

sale.def_en: A time when a shop sells things at a lower price.

same.def_en: Not different; exactly like the other one.

sea.def_en: The salt water that covers much of the earth.
sea.example_en: We swam in the sea all morning.
sea.example_fa: تمام صبح در دریا شنا کردیم.

see.def_en: To notice something with your eyes.

set.def_en: To put something down in a place.

she.def_en: The word for a woman or a girl.

sing.def_en: To make music with your voice.

sit.def_en: To rest with your body on a chair or the floor.

star.def_en: A small light that shines in the night sky.

sun.def_en: The bright light in the sky that gives us day.

table.def_en: Furniture with a flat top and legs.
table.example_en: Put the plates on the table.

tap.def_en: To touch something lightly and quickly.
tap.example_en: Tap the door before you open it.
tap.example_fa: پیش از باز کردن در آرام بزن.

the.def_en: The word for something both people already know.

then.example_en: We ate, then we walked home.
then.example_fa: غذا خوردیم، سپس به خانه رفتیم.

to.def_en: A word that shows direction or a person.

top.example_en: We reached the top of the hill.

treasure.example_en: The pirates buried their treasure here.
treasure.example_fa: دزدان دریایی گنجشان را اینجا پنهان کردند.

tree.def_en: A tall plant with a trunk and leaves.
tree.example_en: A bird is sitting in the tree.

up.def_en: A word that means towards a higher place.

us.def_en: The word for we after a verb or preposition.

versatile.def_en: Able to do many different things well.

vibrant.def_en: Full of life, colour and energy.
vibrant.example_en: The market is vibrant on Saturdays.

water.def_en: The clear liquid that we drink.

water.example_fa: بعد از بازی کمی آب بنوش.

we.def_en: The word for yourself and others together.

weather.def_en: What the sky and air are like outside.
weather.example_en: The weather is cold and windy.

weekend.example_en: We visit grandma at the weekend.

whisper.example_en: He whispered the answer to me.

window.def_en: The glass opening in a wall that lets light in.
